thesis: The top 10 American billion-dollar companies represent the deepest concentration of corporate power in Fortune 500 history. Four tech giants control over a fifth of all Fortune 500 profits while ten companies alone generate $4.5 trillion in combined annual revenue—a structural shift reshaping the U.S. economy.

facts.claim: Amazon (No. 1) surpassed Walmart after 13 years through 12% year-over-year revenue growth and AWS cloud-services margin expansion.
Alphabet recorded a Fortune 500 earnings record of $132 billion in profits, with Nvidia, Apple, and Microsoft—all tech—combining for over 20% of total Fortune 500 earnings.
UnitedHealth Group (No. 3) holds nearly $450 billion in revenue, positioning healthcare as half of the top-ten company composition alongside retail and tech.
Nvidia jumped 15 spots to No. 16 on AI momentum, crossing the $200 billion annual revenue threshold in 2026.
The Fortune 500 is now more concentrated than its 72-year history, with corporate expansion driven by AI, healthcare consolidation, and oligopolistic tech dominance.
Fortune 500 companies represent two-thirds of U.S. GDP, generating $21 trillion in combined revenue and $2.1 trillion in profits across all 500 members.
